---
title: "Shipment Setup"
---

## Iraq Truck Shipment Setup

Fill the form below to create your simulation.

<form id="setupForm">

<div class="form-element">
<label>Number of shipments (trucks):</label>
<input type="number" id="numTrucks" min="1" max="20" value="4">
</div>

<div class="form-element">
<label>Origin Port:</label>
<select id="origin">
  <option>Basra Port</option>
</select>
</div>

<div class="form-element">
<label>Destination:</label>
<select id="destination">
  <option>Baghdad Depot</option>
  <option>Mosul Depot</option>
  <option>Erbil Depot</option>
  <option>Kirkuk Depot</option>
</select>
</div>

<div class="form-element">
<label>Departure Time:</label>
<input type="datetime-local" id="departure">
</div>

<button type="button" onclick="startSim()">Start Simulation</button>

</form>

<div id="status"></div>

<script src="assets/main.js"></script>
